name: Action.ofMulAction_apply
initialProofState:
G H : Type u
inst✝¹ : Monoid G
inst✝ : MulAction G H
g : G
x : H
⊢ Eq ((Action.ofMulAction G H).ρ g x) (HSMul.hSMul g x)
decl:
@[simp]
theorem ofMulAction_apply {G H : Type u} [Monoid G] [MulAction G H] (g : G) (x : H) :
    (ofMulAction G H).ρ g x = (g • x : H) :=
  rfl

decl:

@[simps!]
def leftRegular (G : Type u) [Monoid G] : Action (Type u) (MonCat.of G) :=

name: Action.FintypeCat.toEndHom_apply
initialProofState:
G : Type u_1
inst✝² : Group G
N : Subgroup G
inst✝¹ : Fintype (HasQuotient.Quotient G N)
inst✝ : N.Normal
g h : G
⊢ Eq (((Action.FintypeCat.toEndHom N) g).hom (Quotient.mk (QuotientGroup.leftRel N) h)) (Quotient.mk (QuotientGroup.leftRel N) (HMul.hMul h (Inv.inv g)))
decl:
@[simp]
lemma toEndHom_apply [N.Normal] (g h : G) : (toEndHom N g).hom ⟦h⟧ = ⟦h * g⁻¹⟧ := rfl

name: Action.FintypeCat.toEndHom_trivial_of_mem
initialProofState:
G : Type u_1
inst✝² : Group G
N : Subgroup G
inst✝¹ : Fintype (HasQuotient.Quotient G N)
inst✝ : N.Normal
n : G
hn : Membership.mem N n
⊢ Eq ((Action.FintypeCat.toEndHom N) n) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (Action.FintypeCat.ofMulAction G (FintypeCat.of (HasQuotient.Quotient G N))))
decl:
variable {N} in
lemma toEndHom_trivial_of_mem [N.Normal] {n : G} (hn : n ∈ N) : toEndHom N n = 𝟙 (G ⧸ₐ N) := by
  apply Action.hom_ext
  ext (x : G ⧸ N)
  induction' x using Quotient.inductionOn with μ
  exact Quotient.sound ((QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply).mpr <| by simpa)

name: Action.FintypeCat.quotientToEndHom_mk
initialProofState:
G : Type u_1
inst✝² : Group G
H N : Subgroup G
inst✝¹ : Fintype (HasQuotient.Quotient G N)
inst✝ : N.Normal
x : Subtype fun x => Membership.mem H x
g : G
⊢ Eq (((Action.FintypeCat.quotientToEndHom H N) (Quotient.mk (QuotientGroup.leftRel (N.subgroupOf H)) x)).hom (Quotient.mk (QuotientGroup.leftRel N) g)) (Quotient.mk (QuotientGroup.leftRel N) (HMul.hMul g ↑(Inv.inv x)))
decl:
@[simp]
lemma quotientToEndHom_mk [N.Normal] (x : H) (g : G) :
    (quotientToEndHom H N ⟦x⟧).hom ⟦g⟧ = ⟦g * x⁻¹⟧ :=
  rfl

lemma quotientToQuotientOfLE_hom_mk [Fintype (G ⧸ H)] (h : N ≤ H) (x : G) :
